props.name: variant
props.description: The three empty kinds are distinct variants: first-use (the resource has never had data: onboarding, with the first action), no-results (a search or filter matched nothing: offer to change or clear it), cleared (the user emptied it: confirm, never onboard). loading and error are the other two states. An unknown value falls back to first-use, the neutral onboarding kind, never to a done or no-results message.

props.name: heading
props.description: Visible heading copy. Meaning is never carried by the icon or color alone (WCAG 1.4.1), so every variant renders text. Named heading, not title, because title is a global HTML attribute (a tooltip) and the vanilla options type shares one namespace with the slots; the adapters also accept it as the title slot.

props.name: description
props.description: Optional supporting copy; the adapters also accept it as a slot.

props.name: announce
props.description: Text handed to the live-region registry after mount. Defaults to heading for loading, no-results and error; first-use and cleared are static content and announce nothing unless this is set. No live markup is rendered on the server.

props.name: interrupt
props.description: Only an error that interrupts the user's current task may announce through role=alert (assertive). Everything else, including every loading message and count, uses the polite status region (ADR-006).

slots.name: icon
slots.description: Decorative glyph; always aria-hidden, never the only carrier of the kind.

slots.name: title
slots.description: Heading copy; alternative to the heading prop.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Description copy; alternative to the description prop.

slots.name: actions
slots.description: Next-step controls (SJButton): the first action for first-use, change or clear filters for no-results.
